name: @comma/station
description: The Comma station: still.fail's station extended with the connector's environment work (systems/station/README.md)

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/read/worker.ts --outbase=src --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --external:*.node --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/skills.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs -- node --import ../../scripts/test-network-guard.mjs --test --test-force-exit --test-timeout=600000 test/*.test.ts test/connector/*.test.ts
scripts.test:side: node scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs -- node --import ../../scripts/test-network-guard.mjs --test side/*.test.ts
